decisions.reason: As a simple cleaning product embedded in the firm's core wood-floor system offer, it benefits from strong related knowledge, ongoing customer feedback, and low development risk, so it is likely to be retained.
Maintenance oil is closely tied to the firm's expertise in wooden surface treatment, and the firm's own R&D and installer learning should allow continued refinement rather than withdrawal.
This care line fits the firm's established competence in oiled floors and aftercare, though some overlap within the care assortment leaves a modest rationalisation risk.

High-density underlay foam remains adjacent to the flooring business and can be supported through existing technical and sales capabilities, but as a more standard accessory it still carries somewhat higher portfolio-pruning risk.
The oak parquet line is very close to the firm's core wood-processing, design, and flooring-market knowledge, so absorptive capacity is highest here and withdrawal is unlikely.
